images.title: Which one does the story need?
images.purpose: Recap the decision for the practice set: a story about equal parts with no leftovers leads to the HCF, a story about meeting again leads to the LCM.
images.composition: A simple fork diagram: one box at the left, one grey arrow splitting into two branches to two boxes on the right, generous space between.
exact_structure: Left: one grey #6B7280 outlined box with the text Read the story.
From it, one grey arrow that forks into exactly 2 branches.
Upper branch ends at a teal #0072B2 card with a small icon of one bar cut into 4 equal parts, the text Equal parts, no leftovers, and a reddish purple #CC79A7 badge HCF.
Lower branch ends at an amber #E69F00 card with a small icon of two rows of dots lining up at one ringed place, the text Meets again, and a green #009E73 badge LCM.
No numbers anywhere in the image.
rejection: any number, answer or worked problem shown
the HCF badge on the meeting branch or the LCM badge on the splitting branch
images.takeaway: Decide HCF or LCM from what the story asks before calculating.
images.description: A fork from Read the story to Equal parts, no leftovers with an HCF badge and to Meets again with an LCM badge.
images.context: Shown beside the practice tool on applying HCF and LCM.
images.teaching_notes: Before each problem, point to the branch the story belongs to.

image_decisions.why: A compact decision fork recaps the topic's method without giving away any answer.
